# TaffyGo

> TaffyGo is a free, open-source Chromium browser for Android that blocks ads and trackers. Its built-in assistant, Taffy, works with the AI provider you connect. There is no account, and Matterward Labs runs no server for it.

## Pages

- [TaffyGo, the browser that does the busywork with you](https://taffygo.com/): What the app does, on screens captured from a phone, and how to install it.
- [Hand Taffy an errand | TaffyGo](https://taffygo.com/product/): One errand from the request to the result, in three screens.
- [Built for phones | TaffyGo](https://taffygo.com/built-for-phones/): The bottom row, Taffy's tabs kept apart from yours, and the light and dark themes.
- [Contact | TaffyGo](https://taffygo.com/contact/): Issues, discussions and private security reports, all on GitHub.
- [Privacy policy | TaffyGo](https://taffygo.com/privacy/): What stays on the phone, what goes to websites and to your AI provider, and what reaches us: nothing.
- [Delete your data | TaffyGo](https://taffygo.com/delete-my-data/): There is nothing on our side to delete. How to clear what TaffyGo keeps on the phone.
- [Terms of use | TaffyGo](https://taffygo.com/terms/): The Mozilla Public License 2.0, no warranty, and the services you connect yourself.
- [Open-source licences | TaffyGo](https://taffygo.com/licenses/): Where the notices for the app and for this website are.
